::: {#exm-rss-slr}
#### Residual sum of squares of a simple linear regression

For a [simple linear regression](#def-slr) line
with intercept $\intcoef$ and slope $\coef{x}$,
the fitted value of observation $i$ is $\intcoef + \coef{x} x_i$,
so the residual sum of squares (@def-rss) is a function of the coefficients:

$$\text{RSS}(\intcoef, \coef{x}) = \sumin (y_i - \intcoef - \coef{x} x_i)^2.$$
:::
